sentences.text: Inbound arrivals are checked against the scheduled delivery window before a door assignment is made.
The Yard Gate Controller records vehicle identity, carrier, trailer number, and arrival time.
Yard Gate Controller is also known as Velvetrook.
Drivers follow the gate instructions to the designated staging lane while a receiving door is prepared.
The gate process flags unscheduled arrivals for review before they enter the receiving area.
The Inbound Inspection Desk is also known as Cinderbay.
The Inbound Inspection Desk checks delivery paperwork against the expected shipment and confirms the trailer is presented for inspection.
Staff verify trailer identification and inspect accessible seals before unloading is authorized.
Visible damage, mismatched identifiers, or compromised seals are recorded with the affected shipment details.
The Inbound Inspection Desk sends the Trailer Seal Exception Note when a seal discrepancy requires follow-up.
A receiving door is assigned only when the door, staging lane, and unloading crew are available.
Door assignments are coordinated with the current yard position so that trailers do not obstruct active traffic routes.
The Yard Gate Controller directs each cleared trailer from staging to its assigned receiving door.
If a door becomes unavailable, the trailer remains in a safe holding position until a revised assignment is confirmed.
The Warehouse Management System maintains the expected inbound shipment data used during receiving checks.
The Warehouse Management System sends the Dispatch Wave Amendment when outbound planning requires a change.
Receiving staff compare the physical pallet count with the shipment paperwork before unloading is completed.
Pallets with visible damage are kept separate from acceptable stock while the discrepancy is assessed.
The Inbound Inspection Desk records inspection results promptly so warehouse inventory remains aligned with the received goods.
Door occupancy and clearance are monitored throughout unloading to prevent conflicting vehicle movements.
Yard personnel notify receiving staff when a trailer is ready to leave the door and return to the yard route.
Unloading is paused if an unsafe condition, documentation conflict, or equipment issue is discovered.
The Warehouse Operations Supervisor resolves receiving issues that exceed the desk's routine authority.
The receiving process closes after the shipment count, inspection status, and door release are recorded.
